title: The steps
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Carrying an old dog down wooden steps. The quiet routine. A daily that is only the routine.

panels.composition: The garage porch, morning, rain. WOOD lifting BARNABY from the doorway — one arm under the chest, one under the hips, the way you learn.

image.prompt: a man lifting a very old dog from a doorway with one arm under its chest and one under its hips, a porch in rain, quiet ink with a Payne's gray wash, no words

panels.composition: The cedar steps. Three. Wood taking them one at a time, the dog against his chest.

image.prompt: a man carrying an old dog against his chest down three cedar porch steps one at a time in rain, no words

panels.composition: The gravel. The dog set down. Standing. Doing what he came out to do, slowly, in the rain. Wood waiting with his back turned, giving him that.

image.prompt: an old dog standing on gravel in the rain while a man waits nearby with his back politely turned, no words

panels.composition: The steps again, up. The dog against his chest. The door. The whole daily is the trip down and back.

image.prompt: a man carrying an old dog back up three porch steps to a storm door in rain, no words
image.notes: Nothing but the routine. Four panels of care. It ran on a Monday.

art.line: quiet; water bleeding over the ink edge to suggest rain and fading light
art.palette: desaturated wet-on-wet: raw umber, Payne's gray, Prussian blue, raw sienna
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for the Sundays

notes: The routine. Down and back. The strip gives it the whole daily.
